messages:
Sam: Morning — quick Q: who used the grinder this morning? Dead as of 9:03. :scream: Anyone bring manual burrs?
Lina: that was me, sorry! thought it was the timer. I unplugged it to clean and it didn't restart.
Raj: unplug/replug helped last week for me. Tried that?
Sam: tried; no dice. power light stays off.
kitchen-bot: Maintenance ticket created: #KITCH-412. ETA: 2 days. Low stock: coffee-beans (0), filters (3).
Zoe: I can drop off a cheap grinder by lunch. Also I have cold brew concentrate if we want a backup.
Marcus: I can do a coffee run at 12:15 — is there a preference for beans? dark/medium?
Lina: medium roast please. also can we avoid hazelnut flavored — allergic to tree nuts!
Sam: noted. Marcus pls get medium and a bag of filters. I'll Venmo.
Zoe: Also FYI — someone left a soggy salad in the fridge. Left a note but it's gross. Can we start a 'clear by' label?
Raj: +1 for labels. I made little sticker template: "Name / Date / Toss after: YYYY-MM-DD". Leaving on the counter.
Sam: Also pizza poll? Not everyone, but after the afternoon demo might be nice. React with :pizza: if you want in.
Marcus: :pizza:
Lina: :pizza:
Zoe: I'll only join if vegan option available.
Sam: ok, vegan and regular then. Marcus can you add a salad?
Marcus: yes, pineapple-free promise. (no pineapple on pizza debate is over)
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: Fridge cleanout in 3 days. Auto-delete enabled for items older than 10 days: OFF.
Raj: Thanks all. Small PSA: label prepped meals with 'contains fish' if fish.
Sam: printing stickers tonight. Thanks folks :coffee: :label:
